experiment: FPV / Oblique Multi-view Landmark Grounding + Landmark Appearance Memory

rgb_sources.fpv: AirSim front_0, CityNav Unreal map, camera pitch 0 degrees, exact sampled Pose5D x/y/z/yaw

candidate_set: Fixed CityRefer candidate list from RSRefSeg2 dataset_v1; identical across views per observation
reference_crop: CityRefer contour + dimension projected by pinhole camera model; diagnostic crop only
depth: AirSim DepthPerspective requested; smoke returned constant 1.0, marked unavailable

memory.quality: visible fraction * sqrt(clipped pixel area) * view-angle factor / (1 + distance/100m)

ground_truth_policy: No reference mask or target location enters model inputs; object geometry is used only to render candidate crop labels and calculate diagnostic visibility.
known_limitations: No cached human first-person frames found in released CityNav data.
No valid depth/occlusion response in AirSim smoke test.
Projected landmark crops are geometry-based estimates, not pixel-accurate GT segmentation.
